image_description: A close-up view of a car wheel mounted on a silver vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (black and machined silver). A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim, showing visible tread patterns and sidewall details. The central hub displays a logo and lug nuts. The wheel is situated within the wheel well of the car, with part of the fender and side skirt visible.

artifact_observations.location: Spoke connections to the outer rim
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight inconsistency in the thickness of the spokes where they meet the outer barrel; some connections appear slightly blurred or fused, lacking a clean shadow line.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify it falls under the correct ImageNet subclass.
To check for edge bleeding between the tire and the rim, and ensure the spokes are topologically connected to the hub without floating artifacts.
To verify the spatial relationship between the wheel and the car body (fender), ensuring the wheel sits correctly within the arch without clipping.
To assess the realism of reflections on the alloy surface and the texture of the asphalt ground.

focus_areas: Sharpness and logical consistency of the central hub/lug nuts
Clean separation between tire rubber and metal rim
Reflection coherence on the alloy spokes
Structural integrity of the spoke geometry
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the center hub. AI often struggles with the specific geometry of lug nuts and manufacturer logos, often resulting in symmetrical but nonsensical shapes. Verify if the 'melting' noted in the center is a significant structural defect or just a resolution artifact. Check if the tire tread pattern remains consistent around the visible circumference or if it morphs/disappears illogically.
